versions.name: Camp Toby Tubby
versions.summary: A Natchez Trace Council tent-camping property on Sardis Lake northwest of Oxford in north Mississippi, surrounded by forest and mountain-bike trails with developed campsites and a powered pavilion.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Natchez Trace Council facilities page, which lists Camp Toby Tubby as a current council property (the source's 'Yocona Area Council' label is superseded — that council merged into Natchez Trace Council). Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate (the county-road address did not street-geocode); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's own facilities page; classified as a short-term tent-camping property; features unsurveyed.
